title.en: DSH: dsh-live-compact conflicts with bili compression
title.zh-CN: DSH：dsh-live-compact 与 bili 压缩冲突

desc.en: If your dsh profile has the third-party plugin dsh-live-compact installed, it acts as a competing compaction engine that bili's compaction-disabling overlay cannot see — its checkpoints can land outside bili's knowledge and destroy the compression substrate (#5984). The conflict scan now flags it as a known conflict. If bili should own compression, remove the plugin and restart the profile: dsh plugin remove dsh-live-compact
desc.zh-CN: 如果你的 dsh profile 安装了第三方插件 dsh-live-compact，它是一个 bili 压缩禁用 overlay 看不见的竞争压缩引擎——它的压缩 checkpoint 可能落在 bili 知识之外、摧毁压缩基底（#5984）。冲突扫描现在会把它标记为已知冲突。若要让 bili 持有压缩，请卸载插件并重启 profile：dsh plugin remove dsh-live-compact

hint.en: Source-level analysis in issue #5984: the plugin takes over dsh's stock compaction engine, and its row name never matches bili's overlay.
hint.zh-CN: 源码级分析见 issue #5984：该插件顶替 dsh 的 stock 压缩引擎，其行名永远对不上 bili 的 overlay。
